name: Banana

pros.title: very practical everyday fruit
pros.explanation: Cheap, portable, and easy to use, which matters for a fruit people actually eat often.

pros.title: often easy to tolerate
pros.explanation: A practical plus for many people compared with harsher foods.

pros.title: brings a useful potassium identity
pros.explanation: Not enough to make it elite, but still a real supportive strength.

cons.title: sugar load is fairly high
cons.explanation: Less moderated than the best fruits.

cons.title: glycemic behaviour is only middling
cons.explanation: Not harsh, just not one of the cleanest fruits on this axis.
